ITEM.PTXT: The reflected color is blue, and by lowering the reflectance of yellow and red light (long wavelength range), which feels particularly glaring in the bright "daytime", glare from sunlight and headlights is reduced.
In the dark "nighttime", reflectance equivalent to that of an untinted mirror is ensured to maintain visibility. In addition, the effect of cutting infrared and ultraviolet rays is also enhanced.
